name: KIC 2436209
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 8.5 solar radii and 1.18 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2436209 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 8.492 +/- 0.1461

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2436209 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.1778 +/- 0.0451

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2436209 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4424.1284 +/- 54.6311

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 2436209 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.6528 +/- 0.0045

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.18 solar masses and 8.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,424 K at its surface.
